title: NIST WebBook: Methane gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation
summary: The WebBook lists 5 gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation row(s) for Methane. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation rows for Methane (CAS 74-82-8) print: -74.87 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Chase, 1998, comment: Data last reviewed in March, 1961 (calculated or reviewed row) | -74.6 ± 0.3 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Manion, 2002, comment: adopted recommendation of Gurvich, Veyts, et al., 1991 ; DRB (experimental or compiled row) | -74.5 ± 0.4 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Pittam and Pilcher, 1972, comment: ALS (experimental or compiled row) | -74.85 ± 0.31 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Prosen and Rossini, 1945, comment: Hf derived from Heat of Hydrogenation; ALS (experimental or compiled row) | -73.4 ± 1.1 kJ/mol, method Ccb, reference Roth and Banse, 1932, comment: Reanalyzed by Cox and Pilcher, 1970 , Original value = -75.19 kJ/mol; ALS (experimental or compiled row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
